data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'harsh' and 'deep'. Harsh means harsh, deep means deep. This name signifies strength, determination and courage. It is believed to be bestowed upon a child who will face challenges bravely and emerge victorious. The name Harshdeep carries the meaning “Harsh: harsh, deep: deep” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Harshdeep usually hope their child will grow to embody harsh: harsh, deep: deep and live with faith, good character and purpose.
